Name: ShareX Clip
Author: dev
Description: Region capture with ShareX, putting either the file path or the image on the clipboard.

Actions.Name: Region → File Path
Actions.Tooltip: Capture a region; the saved file's path goes on the clipboard (for terminal Claude Code).

Actions.Name: Region → Image
Actions.Tooltip: Capture a region; the image itself goes on the clipboard (for pasting anywhere else).
